crossRefs.note: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
“You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth…

translations.web: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
translations.bsb: “To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.
translations.kjv: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
translations.asv: To whom then will ye liken me, that I should be equal to him? saith the Holy One.
